updater.title: Update ready
updater.detail: Restarting takes a few seconds. If you are in a call, choose Later, and the update installs the next time you quit.
passkey.hintBody: Passkey sign-in cannot complete here in the app. In this Google window, click "Try another way" and choose your password instead, which works normally.
share.title: Choose what to share
share.subtitle: Everyone in the call sees what you pick.
share.audioHint: Games, music, whatever is playing. The call itself stays out.
share.empty: Nothing to share on this computer.
share.permissionBody: macOS has not given pqp permission to record the screen, so there is nothing for it to offer you. Turn pqp on under Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording, quit pqp, open it again, and share once more.
share.failedBody: pqp could not list the screens and windows on this computer. Try again, and if it keeps happening, restart pqp.
tray.keepInTray: Keep in tray while in a call
